newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' 91-day T-bill rate at 14.022 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' 91-day T-bill rate at 14.022 pct.

text.p: The Philippines' benchmark 91-day Treasury bill rate fell to 14.022 percent from 14.041 percent posted the previous week, the Bureau of Treasury said on Monday.
The rate for 182-day bills was 14.557 percent frommlast week's 14.254 percent, while that for 364 days was 14.868 percent versus 14.377 percent.
The Treasury accepted 1.5 billion pesos out of the 2.05 billion tendered for 91-day bills and all the 1.2 billion tendered for 182-day bills.
For 364-day bills, it accepted 2.0 billion pesos out of the 2.435 billion tendered.
Treasury officials said that because of the problems in the currency market and higher liquidity reserves, they had expected rates at the auction to be slightly higher.
